title: Cyclic Block-Shift Defect Contract

definitions.U: n by m matrix with U[x,j]=1/sqrt(k) iff floor(x/k)=j
definitions.K: n by n permutation matrix with K[x,(x+s) mod n]=1
definitions.S: m by m cyclic shift matrix with S[i,(i+1) mod m]=1

deprecated_domain.reason: Historical execution domain. Not the canonical SV-001-V2 verification domain.

requirements: Every case must satisfy 2 <= m <= 8, 2 <= k <= 8, 1 <= s <= m*k-1.
The verifier must independently construct K, U, Q and D.
The oracle must use the closed-form contract identities.
The verifier must compare independently computed matrix quantities with oracle quantities.
The 5720 historical domain must never be executed by the SV-001-V2 runner.
NaN and infinite comparison values must be rejected.
The final receipt must bind execution to the current repository commit and verification manifest.
A receipt must not be treated as evidence merely because its hash is valid.
